The inference.md patch for unit 9bceb6d953b336e2:0 was supplied only as a truncated excerpt with no head text, so the new Gemma 4 TP foundation section (including any cluster transport/sealed-frame, prompt-prefix or cache claims) was not fully visible. Recommend the next pass check the Gemma TP section in inference.md and prefix-cache.md for cacheSalt scoping, collective-frame sealing/authentication claims and the cluster peer trust boundary against T-041 and the threat model. No concrete security regression is identified from the visible evidence.
